answer_1.quote: Our work builds on this challenge, using the JAMA Clinical Challenge dataset, which provides real-world, complex medical cases along with MCQs and explanations (XPL), allowing us to evaluate the decision-making rationale behind clinical-decision making with LLMs... Each experiment prompted the models to provide both an MCQ response and an accompanying explanation, allowing us to assess bias in both decision‑making and explanation, in a predict‑then‑explain framework.

answer_2.quote: We calculated accuracy scores across dimensions like gender, ethnicity, model type, and prompt variations... We employed statistical metrics to quantify bias: i) Equality of Odds (EO)... ii) SkewSize... iii) Coefficient of Variation (CV)... We also evaluated the models' explanations through their sentence embeddings using SBERT... We used gender bias scores (BiasScore) derived from embedding differences.
